Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

# Phase Two — Gevurah Critique: 24 Improvements

Chesed imagined the ocean; Gevurah gives each wave a shore,
The Awtsmoos reveals through measured vessels so Awtsmoos.com can safely offer more.

1. Keep Home HTML untouched; repair the existing injected spotlight so duplicate markup cannot enter the door.
2. Make the user-supplied public Drive logo primary, while the repository cached PNG becomes a second source once more.
3. Preserve the contract-test filename reference so existing archaeological safeguards do not break at the core.
4. Add an internal `/Shliach/` discovery action while keeping the actual GPT URL immediately visible at the fore.
5. Use four purposeful pages, not arbitrary multiplication, so each route owns a clear search intent and lore.
6. Give every route one H1 and meaningful H2s, preventing decorative-title piles from becoming SEO noise at the door.
7. Keep capability descriptions conditional on authenticated permissions, avoiding promises runtime cannot guarantee or store.
8. Put the exact GPT destination in ordinary anchor markup so navigation survives when JavaScript leaves the core.
9. Launch prompts from a real form submit gesture, reducing popup blocking at the door.
10. Use `URLSearchParams` for encoding instead of hand-built replacements that could mishandle Unicode lore.
11. Open with `_blank` plus `noopener,noreferrer`, preserving origin safety when ChatGPT goes ashore.
12. Make prompt button text explicit about opening ChatGPT, so users understand the transition before.
13. Keep animation decorative and CSS-first; content and controls must be complete before motion enters the floor.
14. Disable nonessential motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`, respecting visitors who ask for less visual roar.
15. Add stable image aspect ratios to prevent layout shift while Drive images load through the door.
16. Use supplied images directly rather than copying hidden variants, making provenance visible and deployment simpler than before.
17. Provide descriptive image alt text tied to meaning, not keyword stuffing accessibility would deplore.
18. Centralize GPT/image constants where appropriate, shrinking drift across the page array we store.
19. Share CSS across every Shliach route to keep identity consistent and maintenance small at the core.
20. Split CSS by responsibility before 120 lines, never compressing selectors merely to fit a score.
21. Split JS by real behavior, not arbitrary mysticism future maintainers cannot explore.
22. Add source-level route contracts only after implementation, then run the existing Home contract from before.
23. Verify actual rendered pages in a browser because source regexes alone cannot prove layout at the door.
24. Finish with a plan-versus-actual delta ledger and zero known relevant work, so completion rests on evidence rather than lore.
